statement: Higher technical skill scores associate with high junior salary hikes.
statistical_method: Mann-Whitney U, Welch's t, Cohen's d, FDR control
empirical_result: SUPPORTED for Maths/Stats (d=1.05, q<0.001) & Storytelling (d=1.04, q<0.001); UNSUPPORTED for Big Data (d=0.22, p=0.217).

statement: Technical skills have unequal, independent associations with junior hike.
statistical_method: Multivariable Logistic Regression (Wald z, AOR, VIF)
empirical_result: SUPPORTED. Maths/Stats (AOR=4.65) and Storytelling (AOR=3.54) independently drive hike; all VIF < 1.35.

statement: Big Five personality traits differ between high and low success seniors.
statistical_method: Mann-Whitney U, Welch's t, Cohen's d, FDR control
empirical_result: SUPPORTED for Conscientiousness (d=1.85, q<1e-15), Openness (d=1.80, q<1e-15), Extraversion (d=1.13, q<1e-9); NOT SUPPORTED for Neuroticism (d=-0.01, p=0.454).

statement: Conscientiousness & Extraversion positively, Neuroticism negatively associate with success.
statistical_method: Multivariable Logistic Regression (Wald z, AOR, VIF)
empirical_result: SUPPORTED for Conscientiousness (AOR=26.79) & Extraversion (AOR=3.93); Neuroticism acted as positive suppressor (AOR=3.94); zero predictive importance in Phase 6.

statement: Required experience positively correlates with advertised salary.
statistical_method: Bivariate OLS & Semi-log with HC3 robust SEs; Spearman rho
empirical_result: SUPPORTED. DS Jobs: beta = 1.98L/yr (p < 1e-134, R2 = 0.352); AJ: r = 0.661 (p < 1e-100).

statement: High-tier salary depends on geographic tech hub and specialized skills.
statistical_method: 7x2 Contingency Chi-square, Haberman residuals, Multivariable Logistic
empirical_result: SUPPORTED. Chi2 = 69.87 (p < 1e-12); NCR (+3.54) and Mumbai (+2.67) premium residuals; Spark (AOR=1.59), ML (AOR=1.58), R (AOR=1.56), SAS (AOR=1.47).
